projects.title: Control Resonant

projects.title: FBC: Firebreak

cover.alt: FBC: Firebreak main menu inside a 3D environment

projects.title: Alan Wake 2
projects.summary: Designed core systems for a narrative survival-horror game: maps, case board, inventory, weapon quick-select and an award-winning photo mode.

work.about: Robotic parcel lockers, warehouse to doorstep.

projects.title: Parcel locker platform
projects.summary: Designed across the whole parcel journey, built the team's first Figma component library, and redesigned back-office software that used to need a 40-page manual.

projects.title: Production analytics
projects.summary: Turned factory data into clear answers for managers, kept the shop-floor tablet app down to a few taps, and led the company rebrand.

approach.title: Structure before pixels
approach.body: I map flows, states and edge cases first. Most complex products get simple once the structure is right, not once the screens are pretty.

approach.title: Design that survives the build
approach.body: Component libraries, clear specs and daily contact with engineers. I plan the work with the team so what ships matches what was designed.

approach.title: Test on the real thing
approach.body: I prototype in code and use AI tools daily. When a working build answers the question faster than a mockup, I skip the mockup.

freelance.intro: Branding and marketing for up-and-coming Estonian music festivals, plus digital painting and vector art from roughly eight years of art school.

body: I'm a designer from Pärnu, Estonia, based in Helsinki. My work has moved from manufacturing SaaS and robotic logistics to AAA game UI. The common thread is taking something complex and making it feel obvious to the person using it.
I work across UX, UI, interaction and visual design, and I like understanding the full stack, from wireframes to motion to front-end, so my designs hold up against real constraints.
I do my best work in-house, close to a product and the people building it, and I'm open to the right freelance collaboration. Outside work: playing and making games, museums, travel and cooking.
